description.value:
A deeper draw on the chakra well. Choose how many actions to spend (1, 2, or 3); you regain twice that many expended spell slots (2, 4, or 6), distributed across any ranks of jutsu you can normally cast. You cannot regain a slot of higher rank than your maximum spell rank.

Frequency consumes one daily use of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves} (shared with all Charge Chakra variants).

Requires the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtExprtChakra0]{Expert Chakra Caster} class feature.
